installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Installation automatique de Pyro Bot pour Pterodactyl
apt update
apt install -y git curl jq ca-certificates file unzip

cd /mnt/server

GIT_ADDRESS=${GIT_ADDRESS:-"https://github.com/SkillFXX/pyro-discord-bot.git"}
BRANCH=${BRANCH:-"main"}

echo "[Pyro Install] Clonage du dépôt Git (${GIT_ADDRESS}, branche: ${BRANCH})..."
if [ ! -d .git ]; then
    git clone --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
else
    git config --global --add safe.directory /mnt/server
    git fetch origin
    git checkout ${BRANCH}
    git pull
fi

# Rendre start.sh exécutable
if [ -f start.sh ]; then
    chmod +x start.sh
fi

# Installation de Node.js 20 si absent du conteneur d'installation
if ! command -v node &> /dev/null; then
    echo "[Pyro Install] Installation de Node.js 20..."
    curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x | bash -
    apt install -y nodejs
fi

echo "[Pyro Install] Installation des dépendances npm..."
npm install --no-audit --no-fund

echo "[Pyro Install] Compilation du Dashboard Web..."
npm run build

echo "[Pyro Install] Génération du fichier .env initial..."
if [ ! -f .env ]; then
    cat << ENVEOF > .env
DISCORD_TOKEN=${DISCORD_TOKEN}
CLIENT_ID=${CLIENT_ID}
GUILD_ID=${GUILD_ID}
DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET=${DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET}
DISCORD_REDIRECT_URI=${DISCORD_REDIRECT_URI}
PORT=${SERVER_PORT:-3000}
SESSION_SECRET=$(head /dev/urandom | tr -dc A-Za-z0-9 | head -c 32)
COOKIE_SECURE=${COOKIE_SECURE:-0}
NODE_ENV=production
ENVEOF
fi

echo "[Pyro Install] Installation terminée avec succès !"
